argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.a: State a claim and arrange its reasons and evidence clearly.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.b: Support the claim with relevant evidence and clear reasoning from credible sources, showing topic understanding.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.c: Connect claims and reasons with suitable words, phrases and clauses.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.1.e: End with a conclusion that follows the argument.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.1: Use grade-appropriate grammar, including correct and consistent pronouns.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.2: Apply capitalization, punctuation and spelling conventions, including punctuation for parenthetical elements.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.3: Choose varied sentence patterns and maintain consistent style and tone.

informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.2: Introduce a topic; organize with relevant strategies such as classification, comparison or cause/effect; develop facts/details/examples, transition between ideas, use precise domain vocabulary, formal style and a fitting conclusion.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.1: Use correct pronoun case, number/person and intensive pronouns; resolve vague references and nonstandard grammar where needed.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.2: Use capitalization, spelling and commas/parentheses/dashes for parenthetical elements.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.3: Vary sentence patterns for meaning and interest; maintain consistent style and tone.

narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.6.3: Establish context and narrator/characters; develop a logical event sequence using dialogue, pacing, description, time/setting transitions, precise sensory details and a fitting conclusion.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.1: Use correct pronoun case, number/person and intensive pronouns; resolve vague references and nonstandard grammar where needed.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.2: Use capitalization, spelling and commas/parentheses/dashes for parenthetical elements.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.6.3: Vary sentence patterns for meaning and interest; maintain consistent style and tone.
